q1.sampleAnswer: She was surprised and thought it was a big change.

keyPoints.descZh: 感到惊讶/觉得这是个很大的变化
examples: She was surprised and thought it was a big change.

q1.rubricZh: 要点：感到惊讶，认为这是个很大的变化。
q1.explanationZh: 看第二段：Auburn 的第一反应是“Oh, my goodness”（天哪），还说“这是个大变化”，所以她很惊讶，觉得变化很大。

evidence.quote: “My first thought was, ‘Oh, my goodness’,” Auburn says. “This is a big change.

q2.sampleAnswer: Rising newsprint costs and falling print readership.
q2.rubricZh: 要点：报纸印刷成本（纸价）上涨；纸质版读者减少。
q2.explanationZh: 第四段说出版商给了两个理由：新闻纸成本上涨，以及读者更喜欢在线新闻，纸质版读者变少。

evidence.quote: Many publishers point to rising newsprint costs.
print readership has fallen in recent years

q3.sampleAnswer: They now save sections of Sunday’s Akron Beacon Journal to read them on Mondays.

keyPoints.descZh: 把周日报纸的部分版面留到第二天（周一）读
examples: save sections of Sunday’s paper to read the next day

q3.rubricZh: 要点：把周日报纸的部分版面留到第二天（周一）再读。
q3.explanationZh: 最后一段说他们还不习惯网上读报，现在会把周日报纸的一些版面留到第二天再读。

evidence.quote: They now save sections of Sunday’s Akron Beacon Journal to read the next day.

q4.sampleAnswer: I prefer reading printed newspapers. I just like the special smell of the ink and the feel of turning the pages. Printed newspapers are also better for my eyes than news apps.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 表明偏好：纸质报纸或新闻 App

examples: Printed newspapers are better for my eyes.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题：明确表明偏好（纸质报纸或新闻 App），并给出合理理由即可。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说你更喜欢哪一种，再给一个合理的理由，比如纸质报纸对眼睛好、App 更方便更快。

evidence.quote: But in the craziness of everyday life, I just scroll through the headlines.
